caption: The drawing depicts a single conical metal object positioned in the center of the composition. The object resembles a pitcher or vessel with a wide circular base that tapers upwards to a narrower top. Attached to one side of the cone is a curved, ribbed handle. On the top surface, there are three vertical cylindrical posts spaced apart and one additional shorter cylindrical post or peg at the center, surrounded by a circular flat lid or plate. The object is rendered in shades of gray, suggesting a metallic texture, and displays areas of shading and highlights for depth. The background is a uniform light beige color with no additional objects or details. In the lower left corner, the signature "A. Goldstein" is visible.
title: Whale Oil Lamp
